description:
Lifting heavy on 5 hours of sleep? In a clinical study from JAMA, healthy men sleeping 5 hours a night saw their testosterone crash by 15% in just 7 days—equivalent to aging 15 biological years.

Workouts tear down muscle tissue; deep sleep is the ONLY window where growth hormone and testosterone rebuild it. If you don't sleep 7-8 hours, your workout is literally working against you.
